# KiteConfig 2.0.1

```kotlin
plugins {
    id("io.github.yuroyami.kiteconfig") version "2.0.1"
}
```

With iOS automatic application enabled, Android Studio and IntelliJ Gradle sync
now updates the Xcode project before Xcode reads it. Changing a version or build
number no longer requires a separate `kiteApplyIos` command after IDE sync.
The hook respects iOS platform selection and shared/per-platform `autoApply`.
Android builds remain platform-scoped, and the existing iOS build hooks remain.

Opening Xcode alone does not run Gradle. If you edit outside the Gradle IDE,
run `./gradlew kiteApplyIos` before archiving.

This release also fixes false `kiteDoctor` / `kiteCheck` drift failures when
Xcode settings differ only in quoting or locale ordering. Sync output now
separates changed values from formatting changes.

No DSL or public binary API changes.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/yuroyami/KiteConfig/compare/v2.0.0...v2.0.1
